summary: The agent's solution contains severe logic and execution errors, including a NameError due to a typo, replacing the target variable with a flattened feature array, and iterating over row indices to create thousands of useless columns. Additionally, the first of two disjoint pipelines lacks `handle_unknown='ignore'` in the OneHotEncoder, causing it to crash on unknown categories in the test set before the later logic can even run. Methodologically, the agent fails to perform any validation (FM06) and applies no feature engineering (FM07).
